zh:
首尔国立大学（Seoul National University，简称SNU）成立于1946年，位于韩国首尔特别市冠岳区，是韩国排名第一的公立研究型大学，也是韩国SKY名校联盟核心成员。学校下设16个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、自然科学、人文社科等领域，在校生超29000人，其中研究生约11000名。
首尔国立大学是韩国最高学术殿堂，2026年将迎来建校80周年，培养了多位诺贝尔奖得主、菲尔兹奖得主，以及大量韩国政府官员、财阀领袖与学术大师。学校在自然科学、工程技术、医学、法学、商学等领域长期稳居韩国首位、亚洲顶尖水平，拥有韩国最顶尖的科研平台与师资力量，在半导体、人工智能、生物医药等领域拥有深厚的学术积淀。2026QS世界大学排名中，首尔国立大学位列世界第39位。
en: Seoul National University (SNU) is South Korea's No.1 public research university, located in Gwanak-gu, Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1946, it is a core member of South Korea's SKY university alliance. The University comprises 16 colleges, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, natural sciences, and humanities, with over 29,000 enrolled students, including 11,000 graduate students. The University will celebrate its 80th anniversary in 2026, and is South Korea's highest academic institution, having produced multiple Nobel Prize winners and Fields Medalists, as well as a large number of Korean government officials and business leaders. Ranked No.39 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
